description: This file defines the TimezoneOffset validation rule class within the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. It checks if a given input falls within the valid range of timezone offsets.

classes.name: TimezoneOffset
classes.description: A validation rule class that verifies whether a timezone offset value is within the accepted range from -12.00 to 14.00.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates whether the input is a numeric value within the timezone offset limits.
